# Deterministic command transcripts

These transcripts execute the real Cobra parsing and dispatch tree against an effect-free documentation lifecycle. `docsgen` output proves syntax and wiring only; it is not DevPod, backend, checkpoint, or release evidence.

## `camp --help`

```console
$ camp --help
Recoverable capsule workspaces

Usage:
  camp [flags]
  camp [command]

Available Commands:
  close       Publish a checkpoint and close
  completion  Generate shell completion
  doctor      Diagnose required host capabilities
  help        Help about any command
  init        Initialize a capsule root
  open        Open a capsule workspace
  recover     Recover an interrupted lifecycle
  reopen      Reopen a closed capsule workspace
  setup       Install or reuse pinned DevPod and Hauler tools
  sync        Publish a checkpoint and remain open

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for camp
      --json   emit stable JSON output

Use "camp [command] --help" for more information about a command.
```
